I have gathered everything needed. Here is the complete picture of the membership tier feature.

## Summary

This is the OfficeFloor-converted Spring PetClinic. The "membership tier" is a **derived, read-only field** computed in the MapStruct `OwnerMapper` from persisted `Owner` fields (`householdSize`, `namesakeCount`, `email`). The `OwnerDto` that carries it is **generated at build time** from `openapi.yml` (openapi-generator-maven-plugin), so there is no checked-in `OwnerDto.java` — the field is defined only in `openapi.yml`. The create flow (`POST /api/owners`) is an OfficeFloor YAML pipeline whose steps populate the inputs the tier depends on.

The test file reveals the intended change: **replace the string `membershipTier` (GOLD/SILVER/BRONZE) with a numeric `membershipLevel` (1–3) on creation.**

## 1. Files referencing the relevant terms

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — defines `membershipTier` (and `namesakeCount`) in the `Owner` schema → generates `OwnerDto`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — computes `membershipTier` string.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — persisted fields `namesakeCount`, `householdSize`, `email` that the tier reads.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CountNamesakes.java` — sets `namesakeCount`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CountHouseholdMembers.java` — sets `householdSize` (GOLD driver).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/LogOwnerAudit.java` — audit line on create.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — the create pipeline.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` — maps entity→DTO for the create response.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` — expects `membershipLevel` (the change target).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` — test harness.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java` — captures the `AUDIT` logger.

Note: `OwnerDto.java` is NOT checked in — it is generated from `openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources` by openapi-generator (pom.xml lines ~369-384). To rename/retype the field you edit `openapi.yml`, not a Java DTO.

## 2 & 4. The tier definition and DTO

**Membership tier computation — `OwnerMapper.java` (lines 29-35):**
```java
@Mapping(target = "membershipTier",
    expression = "java(owner.getHouseholdSize() != null && owner.getHouseholdSize() >= 3 ? \"GOLD\" "
        + ": (owner.getNamesakeCount() != null && owner.getNamesakeCount() == 0 "
        + "&& owner.getEmail() != null && !owner.getEmail().isBlank() ? \"SILVER\" : \"BRONZE\"))")
```
So today: `GOLD` if householdSize ≥ 3; else `SILVER` if namesakeCount == 0 AND email present; else `BRONZE`. Other computed mappings in the same interface: `displayName`, `initials`, `membershipNumber`, `locality`.

**DTO field — `openapi.yml` `Owner` schema (lines 2128-2136):**
```yaml
membershipTier:
  title: Membership tier
  description: The owner's membership tier. 'GOLD' when the owner's household
    (owners sharing the same householdId) has 3 or more members after this create;
    otherwise 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email is present, otherwise
    'BRONZE'.
  type: string
  example: 'SILVER'
  readOnly: true
```
`namesakeCount` is defined just above (lines 2118-2127, `type: integer`, readOnly).

The response DTO returning the tier is the generated `OwnerDto`, produced by `RespondWithOwnerCreated.service(...)` via `ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner)`.

## 3. Audit-line code

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/LogOwnerAudit.java`:
```java
private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");
public void service(@Val Owner owner) {
    AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}",
            owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate());
}
```
It runs as the `audit:` step (after `save`, before `respond`) and does NOT currently log the tier/level. Tests capture the `AUDIT` logger via `AuditLogCapture`.

## 5. The create pipeline

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — guarded by `authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"`. Step order (each `govern: [ transaction ]` where relevant):

`require → normalizeTelephone → normalizeEmail → normalizeAddress → requireUniqueTelephone → requireUniqueHousehold → requireCityCapacity → requireDailyCapacity → build → assignHouseholdId → countHouseholdMembers → applyRegistrationDate → assignCustomerCode → countNamesakes → flagBulkSignup → save → audit → respond`

The steps that feed the tier:
- **`countHouseholdMembers`** (`CountHouseholdMembers.java`) — sets `owner.householdSize` (null when no shared household); drives GOLD.
- **`countNamesakes`** (`CountNamesakes.java`) — sets `owner.namesakeCount` (count of existing owners sharing first+last name, case-insensitive); drives SILVER.
- Email is set earlier via `NormalizeOwnerEmail` / the request body.

The tier itself is not computed in a pipeline step — it is derived only at response time inside `OwnerMapper.toOwnerDto` (called by `RespondWithOwnerCreated`). It is not persisted on `Owner`.

## The intended change (from the test)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`:
```java
/** membership-levels: Replace the string membership tier with a numeric 'membershipLevel' from 1 to 3 on creatio... */
class AcceptanceTest extends AcceptanceBase {
    @Test
    void coreNumericLevel() throws Exception {
        ObjectNode o = ownerNode();
        o.put("firstName", "Uniq"); o.put("lastName", "levelsolo");
        o.put("email", uniqueEmail());
        int id = createOwnerOk(o);
        getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.membershipLevel").value(3)); // 1 +email +namesake0, capped 3
    }
}
```
The test implies an additive scoring model (base 1, +1 for email, +1 for namesakeCount==0, capped at 3) returned as an integer field named `membershipLevel`. Implementing it requires: (a) renaming/retyping the field in `openapi.yml` (`membershipTier` string → `membershipLevel` integer), and (b) rewriting the `@Mapping` expression in `OwnerMapper.java` to compute the numeric level. `GET /api/owners/{id}` also returns `OwnerDto` via the same mapper, so no read-path change is needed beyond the mapper/schema.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code on input; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+()0-9 -]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-only flag. When true, the owner may share a last name and
            address with an existing owner (the household-duplicate rule is bypassed).
            Not persisted and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true; null otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The owner's membership tier. 'GOLD' when the owner's household
                (owners sharing the same householdId) has 3 or more members after this create;
                otherwise 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email is present, otherwise
                'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration date at the moment it was created (a high-volume
                sign-up day); false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
